name: mathmodel-skill
description: A Huawei Cup-specific ten-stage workflow with per-question human approval, data isolation, candidate-model comparison, MATLAB figures, paper traceability, and current-rule compliance review.

interface.shortDescription: 华为杯逐题隔离、模型决策与 MATLAB 论文工作流
interface.longDescription: A Huawei Cup-focused Codex workflow that isolates every subproblem's interpretation, data, candidate models, validation, and figures behind human approval gates. Ten staged checkpoints, persistent state, deterministic audits, MATLAB evidence figures, paper traceability, and current-rule review keep the 100-hour contest workflow coherent.
defaultPrompt: Use $mathmodel-skill to prepare my Huawei Cup team and audit problem interpretation.
Use $mathmodel-skill to compare current Huawei Cup problem choices and record the decision.
Use $mathmodel-skill to run a compliance-first final review of our Huawei Cup paper.
